name: orga-audit
description: UX/a11y audit harness for underground.folkup.life — uses Playwright + axe-core from sibling dayforge project (no local install).

notes.no-dependencies: Intentional. @playwright/test@1.58.2 and @axe-core/playwright@4.11.1 are consumed from ../../dayforge/node_modules via NODE_PATH in run.js. This avoids duplicating ~250MB and reuses already-downloaded browser binaries.
